page.title: Portfolio
page.headline: We go to the ends of the earth for world-class founders.

children.text: Attio is the AI-native CRM that builds, scales, and grows your company to the next level.

Mistral partners with organizations in high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, energy, and the public sector to co-create tailored AI systems to solve their hardest, most high-value problems.

Black Forest Labs is the frontier AI research lab for visual intelligence. Deeply rooted in foundational research, BFL continuously builds state-of-the-art technology to empower creators, developers, and enterprises to bring their imagination to life. The BFL team pioneered Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX.1 - milestones that transformed generative AI and made text-to-image generation accessible to millions.
Verse is making quality in-home healthcare possible.
Owner is an AI operating platform for restaurants to grow sales, discovery, and repeat orders.
Natural Cycles is a mobile app designed to help women track their fertility.
Grüns is a health and wellness company that offers nutrition supplements in the form of gummy snacks.
AMI is building a new class of AI systems based on world models; systems designed to understand the real world.
Raisin democratizes the global deposit, investment, and pension markets – benefitting people and financial institutions alike.

Fundamental builds AI models to analyze and predict from structured, tabular enterprise data. Its flagship model, NEXUS, is designed to help companies make better forecasts and decisions from their internal records.
Pismo is a financial processing solution that helps users manage current and legacy products with next-generation technology, while enabling innovative payment solutions in a single platform.
Heidi is an ambient AI medical scribe that automates clinical documentation, reducing administrative burden and enabling healthcare professionals to focus more on patient care.
Sonos is a wireless multi-room music system enabling users to play music anywhere in the house and control it using a smartphone.
Fetch is America’s leading consumer-engagement platform that rewards shoppers for buying the brands they love.
Housecall Pro is a digital business management tool for service professionals.
Creditas is Brazil's leading consumer lending product, providing low interest, secured loans.
Gopuff is the go-to solution for immediate everyday needs, delivering food, snacks, drinks, home essentials, baby products and pet necessities, over-the-counter medicine and much more in minutes.
The RealReal is an online and brick-and-mortar marketplace for authenticated luxury consignment.
Fonoa is an AI operating system for global indirect tax.
Segment unifies customer data from every touchpoint, empowering marketing, sales, and customer service leaders with the insights they need to deepen engagement.
Brite Payments is an open banking platform that offers merchants the full benefits of instant payments.
Scopely is an American interactive entertainment company and mobile games developer and publisher.
Motion is a Creative Analytics platform that combines visual content with performance metrics to help growth teams improve their creative strategy.
Icertis enables cloud-based contract management.
Acorns is a long-term saving and investing product that enables users to make automatic micro-investments in professionally designed portfolios.

Sereact builds physical AI for warehouses and manufacturing. Its Cortex brain runs across single-arm picking cells, dual-arm returns stations, humanoid robots, and Sereact Lens, a 3D perception system for inventory and quality control.
Farfetch brings luxury products from over 1,300 of the world’s best brands, boutiques and department stores into a single shopping experience.
Goop is a wellness and lifestyle focused content and ecommerce brand founded by Gwyneth Paltrow.
Bitwarden is a free and open-source password manager for individuals, teams, and businesses.
Airvet is a telehealth platform that provides continuity of care between pet parents and veterinarians.
Citizen Health is building an AI-based consumer health platform that leverages data to accelerate care and treatments for rare diseases.
Buk is a cloud-based human resource management platform that unifies a wide range of HR functionality into a single system.
Exein is building a healthier future for digital life by protecting your Physical AI Systems with self-sustaining cybersecurity solutions.
Nivoda is the B2B marketplace for diamonds & jewellery.
Axios is a media company that delivers vital, efficient news and analysis.
Angi is an online home services directory that makes it easy to find trusted pros for any home project — and get the job done right, guaranteed.

Olist connects merchants and their products to the main marketplaces of Brazil. It has developed a platform for shopkeepers of all sizes and segments to register their products to be sold at the Olist store within Brazil's top retailers.
Honeycomb provides full-stack observability for engineering teams to understand, debug, and improve production systems.
Carewell curates adult care supplies to improve the lives of caregivers and their families.
Podimo is a subscription service for podcasts & audio content.
Didero is putting supply chains on autopilot, starting with direct goods procurement for physical supply chains.
Air is a collaborative platform for managing creative operations from inspiration to asset archival.
AirGarage is the 21st-century parking operator. They handle everything it takes to run parking assets.
Plancraft digitizes work processes for craft businesses, streamlining tasks like invoicing, project calculation, construction site documentation, and time tracking.
Numa is a tech enabled hospitality brand, offering uniquely designed apartments for the modern traveler.
SEMrush enables companies to reach the right audiences through SEO, advertising, content marketing, and social media. Their 50+ tools have been applied by millions of users worldwide.
Homa is a complete tool stack for game creativity. Data, publishing, monetization. Homa brings the science, creators can focus on letting their imagination go.
Finom develops an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
Staffbase supports industry leaders with their own branded app to engage their diverse, disconnected, and distributed workforce.

seo.description: Meet the Headliners! Explore Headline’s portfolio companies worldwide, filter by sector, and see the founders Headline back from early stage through global scale, across software, fintech, AI, consumer, and more, backed by teams on the ground in major markets.
